function.name: execute_bash

content:
cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && grep -n "ICONV" Makefile | head; echo "--- check iconv test compile ---"; cat > /tmp/ict.c <<'EOF'
#include <iconv.h>
int main(){ iconv_t c=iconv_open("UTF-8","UTF-8"); iconv(c,0,0,0,0); iconv_close(c); return 0; }
EOF

581:WITH_ICONV = 1
--- check iconv test compile ---


gcc -o /tmp/ict /tmp/ict.c 2>&1 | head; echo "rc=$?"; /tmp/ict; echo "run rc=$?"
rc=0
run rc=0
